title: Connect the machine
summary: Once: gSender on this laptop sees the machine. Nothing is cut here.
facts: USB from the controller to this laptop

steps.text: Check that the **emergency stop** is released: turn it along the arrow.
Switch the machine on and plug its **USB cable** into this laptop.
Close any other sender (Candle, UGS, a second gSender).
steps.note: Only one program can hold the machine's port.

steps.text: Start **gSender**, press **Connect** and pick the machine's port (`CH340`, `FTDI` or `CP210x`).
steps.note: No port: unplug USB, plug it back, wait 10 s. Still none: tell Claude.

steps.text: The state turns `Idle` or `Alarm`. On `Alarm` press **Home**: the machine drives to its switches. Hands away from the axes.
Tell Claude **connected**. It reads the machine settings next, without moving anything.
